top_signals.title: Statement by President von der Leyen with NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte
top_signals.summary: European Commission Statement Brussels, 02 Sep 2026 We meet today to discuss Russia's attack in Leipzig. The German government has identified Russia as behind an attempt to attack cargo planes at Leipzig/Halle Airport. Had this attack succeeded, this would have resulted in enormous damage and possibly even loss of life. So I want to be very clear about what this was. This was an attack using military-grade material, carried out by Russian operatives on EU soil.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: How Women Are Shaping Drag Racing
top_signals.summary: Drag racing has outpaced Formula 1, NASCAR and IndyCar on inclusivity, offering a model for sports that still treat women competing at the highest level as a novelty, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Adam Minter says. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: U.S. Oil Rig Count Rises as Gas Rig Activity Declines
top_signals.summary: The total number of active drilling rigs for oil and gas in the United States stayed the same this week, according to new data that Baker Hughes published on Friday, with the total rig count in the US staying at 588, up 51 from this same time last year. The number of active oil rigs rose by 2, reaching 449 during the latest reporting period, according to the data. This is 35 above this same time last year.
